This is an early OBrush sculpting alpha for macOS Apple Silicon. The app is
ad-hoc signed and has not been notarized by Apple. Verify the ZIP against
`SHA256SUMS.txt` before opening it. The ZIP includes the project licenses,
bundled-asset notices, and exact source/build hashes.

Save your work explicitly. SculptGL and ZBrush feature parity, autosave,
recovery, and broad pen/device validation are still unfinished. Report
reproducible problems through the bug-report issue form and use the feature
request form to propose and vote on priorities.
